# MindMap

**Class:** `UltraCanvasMindMap` · **Group:** [Diagrams](../Groups/Diagrams.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasMindMap.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasMindMap.h) · `#include "Plugins/Diagrams/UltraCanvasMindMap.h"`

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasMindMap> CreateMindMap( const std::string& id, int x, int y, int w, int h);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasMindMap(const std::string& id, int x, int y, int width, int height);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

## Option types in this header

### enum `MindMapTheme`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Default` |  |
| `Professional` |  |
| `Colorful` |  |
| `Pastel` |  |
| `Dark` |  |
| `HandDrawn` |  |

### enum `MindMapConnectorStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Straight` |  |
| `Curve` | Cubic bezier, the classic mind map look |
| `Elbow` | Orthogonal, sharp corners |
| `RoundedElbow` | Orthogonal with rounded corners |
| `TaperedBranch` | Organic branch, thick at the parent and thin at the child |

### enum `MindMapConnectorColorMode`

Where a connector takes its colour from.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `InheritFromBranch` | The branch hue (default) |
| `InheritFromChild` | The child node's border colour |
| `Fixed` | Always MindMapStyle::connectorColor |

### enum `MindMapConnectorAttach`

Where a connector meets a node (R4).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Perimeter` | Nearest point on the node outline (default) |
| `Baseline` | The node's bottom edge, the classic mind map convention |

### enum `MindMapEndDecoration`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NoDecoration` | Not "None" - X11 defines None as a macro |
| `Arrow` |  |
| `Dot` |  |
| `Square` |  |

### enum `MindMapNumbering`

How a topic's ordinal is displayed (C8).

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Off` |  |
| `Prefix` | "1.2 Topic text" |
| `Badge` | Filled circle in the branch hue, drawn before the node |
